me.line: You smile now, I can see its pieces still stuck in your teeth
stanza: You called me "angel" for the first time, my heart leapt from me
You smile now, I can see its pieces still stuck in your teeth
And what's left of it, I listen to it tick
Going unknown as any angel to me

partner.line: You called me "angel" for the first time, my heart leapt from me

me.linePrev: Spittin' like a villain in the pantomime old shoes
me.lineNext: Drinking in the rain with my ghost

partner.line: But I never really wondered what they gave me

stanza: Like the damp grass that yields to me
Like these insects that feast on me
And yours among them, I know

partner.line: Like these insects that feast on me
